verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's pricing page directly claims "Unlimited calendars: Google, Microsoft, iCloud, and Fastmail, all checked for conflicts." That covers every provider named in the story (Google, Outlook via Microsoft, Apple via iCloud) and the conflict-checking behavior. The support rests on that single marketing line, though. missing for 10: in-depth setup or conflict-checking documentation (e.g., per-calendar selection, sync frequency), independent or hands-on corroboration that double-bookings are prevented across providers.
